title: Zustandsmodell: Continuous/Discrete Properties
description: Enhance ProLinkControllerState to distinguish continuous vs discrete controller properties. Add explicit property type classification (continuous range vs discrete on/off) based on observed properties fields. Evidence class: RUNTIME_CONFIRMED.

evidenceRequirements.description: Enhanced controller state model with continuous/discrete property classification
State model tests for property type detection

acceptanceCriteria: ProLinkControllerState classifies controller as continuous or discrete based on properties
Discrete detection: checks if bounds_a_raw/bounds_b_raw indicate 0/1 range or unit suggests boolean
Continuous detection: numeric bounds with range > 1 or continuous units (dB, Hz, etc.)
State preserves existing behavior for backward compatibility
Tests cover both continuous and discrete controller scenarios
